nodes.name: theme-blue.css
nodes.summary: Defines blue-accented light and dark theme tokens for surfaces, text, interactive colors, charts, sidebars, radii, and shadows.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses OKLCH color tokens under data-theme selectors with a paired `.dark` variant.
